title: Songs in front of you
description: Large material to play from, with page turns you control and an order for the songs.

blocks.text: At rehearsal a person plays with both hands and can’t keep moving the screen.

quote.text: Love this app for ease in collecting songs, creating set lists, etc. But as someone who uses in live situations, I need Autoscroll and it has stopped working. I’ve tried resetting - no good. Deleting and downloading. Nope.

blocks.text: Put together your own list, set the size of the lines and the speed of the scroll. Check the difficult changes in advance, and that the movement can be stopped quickly.
Reading mode has to open without editing the text by accident.
